description: What a stretch. For the last 5+ weeks, I've been fully engaged in meeting the Virginia Elections requirement to have 1000 validated, registered voters from your district sign a petition to allow someone to be placed on the ballot. I hadn't done anything like that before, and I live in a pretty dense part of town, so I figured it wouldn't be a big deal. Another lesson learned for the new guy.
